notes.note: 'Same concept, five doors' (deeper, ELI5, visual, hands-on, quiz) is genuinely good product thinking for a textbook. But you're competing with free LLMs that already do all five doors on demand, and institutional sales ($3/student/yr) are a grind. The simulator-preset library is the only moat-shaped idea here.
